status.en: Graduating in early 2027 — actively seeking Applied Scientist / Research Engineer roles.

bio.en: I work on time-series, edge AI, and explainability for mobile robots at IRIT (Université Toulouse Capitole) and TwinswHeel. My research focuses on adapting and distilling deep foundation models into lightweight, adaptive architectures for low-latency onboard anomaly detection.
bio.fr: Je travaille sur les séries temporelles, l'Edge AI et l'explicabilité pour les robots mobiles à l'IRIT (Université Toulouse Capitole) et chez TwinswHeel. Mes recherches portent sur l'adaptation et la distillation de modèles de fondation profonds en architectures légères et adaptatives pour la détection d'anomalies embarquée à basse latence.

research.title: Foundation Models & Edge AI
research.description: Distilling and adapting deep time-series foundation models for real-time edge anomaly detection.

research.title: Explainability (XAI)
research.description: Using SHAP contributions to analyze detector complementarity and ensure reliable decisions under domain shifts.

research.title: Time Series & Multi-Agents
research.description: Interactive and multi-agent ensemble learning for multivariate time series classification and fault detection.
